common.tagline: Mud-soaked world of trench warfare and Imperial hyperbarride mining.
common.famousFor: The Mimban Campaign — a slow grinding war the Empire pretends is over. Coaxium-grade mineral mines.
common.cantinaReputation: Swamp world locked in perpetual war. The Empire runs brutal mining operations, drafting locals as laborers. Endless mud, rain, and misery. Not where you want to crash-land, but the abandoned Clone Wars-era bases scattered across the surface sometimes have working fuel cells and med supplies.
